title: PLA Rocket Force purges and a possible hidden Chinese program

tellings.quote: there were some recent purges in the last few years in like the rocket forces which you know

plain: Matthew Pines, a researcher who writes about national security, notes on Jesse Michels' podcast that in recent years China's leader Xi Jinping has removed many officers from the Rocket Force, the branch of China's military that runs its missiles. Pines raises the idea that these purges might be connected to a hidden Chinese program, which would mean China has its own secret effort of the kind the podcast discusses.
